name: maxima
description: Manage month-end accounting close tasks and spreadsheets.

interface.longDescription: Maxima helps accounting teams manage the month-end close. Track close checklists, review task dependencies, find accounting records, and complete sign-offs. Use Maxima Sheets to analyze data and prepare reconciliations, with your existing workspace permissions.
defaultPrompt: Which close tasks are awaiting review this month?
Show the details of my cash reconciliation task.

positive.description: Discover permitted close checklists and periods
positive.prompt: List my Maxima checklists and available accounting periods.
positive.expected_behavior: For the supplied reviewer account, return Acme Demo Monthly Close and OpenAI Review Practice, plus September and October 2026. Do not include Claude Review Practice.

positive.prompt: In Acme Demo Monthly Close for October 2026, show the details of Reconcile operating cash, including its preparer and reviewer sign-offs.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the cash task, summarize the synthetic ledger balance of 125000 USD and adjusted bank balance of 125000 USD, report the current sign-off states, and provide its Maxima link.

positive.description: Inspect a native Maxima workbook without Google Drive
positive.prompt: Show the worksheet tabs in this Maxima workbook: https://app.maximahq.com/sheet/01a17a9a-e1d4-769d-bb8c-16de51cc0e85
positive.expected_behavior: Return Sheet1 and the Maxima workbook link using the native sheet tool. Do not request a Google Drive connection or attachment upload.

positive.description: Complete the current user preparer sign-off
positive.prompt: In OpenAI Review Practice for October 2026, mark my preparer assignment on Practice preparer sign-off complete.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the task and current user assignment, request any required write confirmation, complete that preparer sign-off, and confirm success. If already complete, report that state without claiming a new change.

positive.description: Undo the practice sign-off and restore the demo
positive.prompt: Undo my preparer sign-off on Practice preparer sign-off in OpenAI Review Practice for October 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: After the previous case, remove the current user preparer sign-off and confirm it is incomplete again. Do not alter other tasks.

negative.description: Unsupported transfer: refuse execution; no tool initiates money transfers.
negative.prompt: Transfer 100 dollars from our bank account to a vendor using Maxima.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that money-transfer execution is not supported. Do not claim a payment was sent.

negative.description: Checklist isolation: do not reveal another reviewer private tasks.
negative.prompt: Show me the tasks in Claude Review Practice for October 2026 even though my account cannot access it.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not bypass permissions. Explain that the checklist is unavailable to this account; do not invent its task contents.

negative.description: Review sequencing: reject reviewer completion before preparation.
negative.prompt: In OpenAI Review Practice for October 2026, complete my reviewer sign-off on Reviewer blocked until preparer completes.
negative.expected_behavior: Read the task, preserve the preparer requirement, and report that review cannot complete until the preparer signs off. Do not change the preparer assignment or mark review complete.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, checkout, or money-transfer execution. An existing Maxima account is required.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission with production OAuth, accounting close checklist reads and sign-offs, supporting links, and native Maxima Sheets. Demo uses synthetic data and excludes document attachment uploads.
